test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

When did you call me?

options.text: When have I called by you ?
When was I called by you?
When was you called by me?
When were you called by me?

solution:
The correct answer is: "**When was I called by you?**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in active voice with the subject "**you**" performing the action of calling.
 
• To convert it into passive voice, we need to make the object of the sentence (i.e. "**me**") the subject and use the past participle of the verb "call" (i.e. "**called**").
 
• The auxiliary verb "**was**" is used to form the passive voice in the past tense.
 
• The preposition "**by**" is used to indicate the agent (i.e. the person or thing performing the action), which in this case is "**you**".

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.
